recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait rendered in a heavy, expressive impasto style. The subjects are three young Black males positioned closely together, featuring visible, thick brushstrokes that prioritize texture and light over precise anatomical detail. The background is a fragmented, abstract interior composed of warm ochre and cool blue blocks of color.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking figures creating a central vertical mass
Contrast between bright white clothing and dark, saturated backgrounds
Rhythmic repetition of thick, directional brushstrokes across all surfaces
Warm skin tones balanced by cool blue accents in clothing and background
coreInvariants: Visible oil paint texture and ridges
High-contrast lighting with bright highlights on clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the central 70% of the frame, arranged in a staggered triangular formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in white, whose head is tilted, serves as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the leaning figure on the left, down to the central figure, and up to the standing figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, filled with abstract blocks of color representing an interior room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sienna tones in the background and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue and stark titanium white in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright cyan highlights within the shadows and background fragments.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirts and dark trousers/background; medium saturation throughout.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for functional labeling only.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary clean, geometric structure for a functional label.
Offers a slightly more industrial feel that matches the raw texture of the paint.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting of three young Black men standing together. Use thick, visible impasto brushstrokes. The lighting should be high contrast, with two figures wearing bright white shirts and one in a dark blue sweater. The background should be an abstract, painterly interior with ochre and blue tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, three-line block of uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom right corner. The text should be a dark red color and have a clean, modern appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the paint texture clearly visible as ridges?
Are the faces expressive but not hyper-realistic?
Is the text placed in the bottom right without obscuring key facial features?

adjustableVariables: Color of the third figure's sweater
Degree of abstraction in the background
mustRedesign: Any existing logos or brand marks

mustAchieve: Tactile, physical feel of oil paint
Strong sense of light and shadow
avoid: Sharp, clean vector lines in the illustration

postGenerationChecks: Check for impasto texture consistency across the canvas
Ensure the white shirts have varied tones of grey and blue in the shadows
Verify the text is legible but secondary to the artwork
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical poses
recipe.reuseFormula: Impasto Portrait Style + High Value Contrast + Geometric Metadata Overlay
